info.title: OpenXet
info.description: The HTTP API of an OpenXet server: the Xet CAS, the Hugging Face Hub API, Git smart HTTP, Git LFS and the file gateway. Every error is `{"schema":"openxet.error.v1","code","message","hint"}`: `code` is stable, `hint` names the next action. Every answer carries `X-Request-Id`.

post_datasets_ns_name_git_upload_pack_40.description: `cas_credential`: a CAS token, which only the CAS routes take.

post_datasets_ns_name_git_upload_pack_42.description: `too_many_requests`: the reachability check is over its concurrency limit for the repository or the caller. `Retry-After: 1`.

post_datasets_ns_name_info_lfs_objects_b.description: Each object with its actions or its error. An upload's `xet` actions carry a capability `href` and the CAS token in `X-Xet-*` headers; a download's `href` is the file gateway's.

result.description: `1` if the shard or any of its files was new to the scope, `0` if all were registered already.

post_shards_400.description: `invalid_path`: the path holds a percent-encoded byte. `invalid_hash`: a hash is not 64 lowercase hex characters. `bad_request`: the body ended before its `Content-Length`, or its transfer was malformed. `shard_malformed`: the body doesn't parse as an upload shard. `shard_verification_failed`: it doesn't verify against the stored xorbs. `unknown_xorb`: a file references a xorb that isn't stored or visible. Final.

post_shards_403.description: `insufficient_scope`: a read token on a route that writes.

post_shards_408.description: `body_timeout`: the body stalled or fell below `server.body_min_rate`. The answer closes the connection; retry.

post_shards_503.description: `not_ready`: the server is starting. `Retry-After: 1`. `unavailable`: the index or bucket failed in a way a retry may fix. `memory_busy`: the memory budget stayed full for 120 s. `Retry-After: 1`.

post_v1_reconstructions_408.description: `body_timeout`: the body stalled or fell below `server.body_min_rate`. The answer closes the connection; retry.

post_v1_telemetry_400.description: `invalid_path`: the path holds a percent-encoded byte. `invalid_hash`: a hash is not 64 lowercase hex characters. `bad_request`: the body ended before its `Content-Length`, or its transfer was malformed.

put_api_openxet_v1_repos_ns_name_labels_.description: `invalid_label`: the label is not a lowercase slug of `a`-`z`, `0`-`9` and `-`, 1 to 64 bytes, or the repository carries 32 already.
`labels_changed`: the labels changed concurrently; nothing was changed. Retry.

Cache-Control.description: `no-store`: the answer depends on the caller's credential.

X-Error-Code.description: huggingface.co's error code (`RepoNotFound`, `RevisionNotFound`, `EntryNotFound`, …), where it defines one.

X-Error-Message.description: The message, as `huggingface_hub` shows it; characters a header can't carry are `?`.

X-Request-Id.description: The request's id, under which the server logged it. Give it to the operator.

accessToken.description: An OpenXet access token, which the Hub's token routes exchange for CAS tokens.

accessTokenBasic.description: An OpenXet access token as the password; the user name is ignored.

casToken.description: A static token or a CAS token (docs/reference/config.md#static-tokens).

signedUrl.name: sig
signedUrl.description: A URL the server signed and handed out: its `sig` query parameter, with the others it signs, is the whole credential. Use the URL exactly as given.

tags.name: health
tags.description: Liveness and readiness probes, without a credential.

tags.name: cas
tags.description: The Xet CAS API as stock clients call it (https://huggingface.co/docs/xet/api). Routes: docs/reference/routes.md.

tags.name: hub
